title: [COMMUNITY PUBLISHER ACCESS] Add samueltargino0567-ux , Derlifed to the list
author: gggff123

gist.summary: Added samueltargino0567-ux and Derlifed to the GitHub allowlist for community model publishers, granting those accounts publishing access. Closes #16608 and #16645.

image.prompt: In a cozy pixel art garden workspace, Polli wears a tiny librarian hat and places two GitHub account cards beside a community model publishing terminal, with code-plants growing nearby. The main character is a cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body and dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks on cheeks, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings; she is small-to-medium sized within the scene, never oversized, strictly pixel art style, never realistic. Cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, with prominent lime green (#ecf874), warm cream, and dark purple (#110518) accents.
